#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
    return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
}

string next() {
    int c = getchar();
    while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
        c = getchar();
    }
    string res;
    while (!isSpaceChar(c)) {
        res.push_back((char)c);
        c = getchar();
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int N = stoi(next());
    string Str = next();
    int count = 0, par = 0, wordInPar = 0, max_length = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Str.length(); i++) {
        char c = Str[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '_':
                if (par == 0) {
                    max_length = max(max_length, count);
                } else if (count > 0) {
                    wordInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
                break;
            case '(':
                par = 1;
                max_length = max(max_length, count);
                count = 0;
                break;
            case ')':
                par = 0;
                if (count > 0) {
                    wordInPar++;
                }
                count = 0;
                break;
            default:
                count++;
                break;
        }
        if (par == 0) {
            max_length = max(max_length, count);
        }
    }
    cout << max_length << " " << wordInPar << endl;
    return 0;
}
